episodes.synopsis: Hisone Amakasu enlists in the Air Self-Defense Force, where an encounter with a dragon concealed inside a hangar alters her career path forever.
episodes.title: It Is Insane

episodes.synopsis: After her successful test run flying the dragon, Hisone is asked by flight suit developer Hiroki Ikushima to review prototype suits.
episodes.title: I Name the Dragon Masotan

episodes.synopsis: Promoted to technical sergeant, Hisone undergoes fighter pilot training with the F-15J unit. The Gifu Air Base prepares for its annual air show.
episodes.title: Take Responsibility, Would You?

episodes.synopsis: Joined by pilots and their dragons from other military bases, Hisone participates in a joint training exercise held at the Gifu Air Base.
episodes.title: Those Guys Have Come Over to Gifu

episodes.synopsis: Sent to a remote island for a field training exercise, the dragon pilots are given a week to escape back to Gifu Air Base using any method they can.
episodes.title: Who Likes to Be Disliked?

episodes.synopsis: While Hisone, Liliko and Mayumi await their scheduled extraction from the remote island, El is determined to leave before their time is up.
episodes.title: I Will Call Your Name

episodes.synopsis: Fearing that romantic relationships may become a distraction, Iiboshi orders the airbase staff to assess the relationship potential of each pilot.
episodes.title: Kingdom of Love

episodes.synopsis: As Iiboshi reveals the true mission behind the dragon pilot program, a former pilot from long ago appears before the Gifu Air Base flight crew.
episodes.title: Limited Time Offer! Spicy Granny Flavor

episodes.synopsis: With the mission date nearing, the dragon pilots are sent on a test run. One of the shrine maidens questions Hisone's relationship with Okonogi.
episodes.title: Eeeeeeeeeek!

episodes.synopsis: A ceremony is held to select which shrine maiden will lead the ritual. Zaito is ordered to make a difficult decision for the sake of El's career.
episodes.title: Melty Love

episodes.synopsis: While Hisone follows through with her career decision, the remaining dragon pilots accompany Okonogi and the shrine maidens on their joint mission.
episodes.title: Montparnasse Sky and Scum Girl

episodes.synopsis: As the mission proceeds under the watchful eye of the command center, Hinomoto reflects upon the events that transpired during the previous ritual.
episodes.title: Invincible Us
